name: PowerDNS Recursor Self-Hosted
free_limit: GPL-2.0 open-source recursive DNS resolver with caching, DNSSEC validation and Lua scripting; free to deploy and run on your own infrastructure without vendor query quotas.
watch_out: Not an authoritative DNS hosting plan or provider-managed free DNS service; requires your own server, public-network/security configuration and operational resources. Commercial support and PowerDNS enterprise add-ons cost extra.
